purpose: A titled row of three linked article cards on one hairline frame grid with no gutter, stacking to one column on mobile. Each card is a single link: a 16:9 media cell holding the article's cover — or, when it has none, the client's mark in one flat ink that follows the theme — then the headline, the deck and a `meta` overline pinned to the foot. It is a page section — the site places it from a `{ _id: 'article-cards-section', props }` entry and binds `props` straight onto it — and it composes `module`, `module-header`, `registration-frame` and `card-grid`. `variant` places the heading only: `start` at the start (an article's closing row), `center` centred over the cards under an overline (a landing-page band); the cards keep the same shape in both.
useWhen: To close a blog post with its related articles, or a success story with its related stories.
To show three stories as a landing-page band under a centred heading.
avoidWhen: For the full, filterable list of articles → use `article-index-section`.
For one featured article selected from a wall → use `article-highlight-section`.
related: `card-grid` — the frame grid the cards sit on.
bestPractices: Give a card either `image` or `mark`; the mark is drawn only when there is no cover.
Keep the band to three cards so the frame row stays full.
Set `target: '_blank'` on a card whose article lives on another site; it opens in a new tab and says so to assistive technology.
